items.author: Nikunj Kothari
items.summary: FPV Ventures partner Nikunj Kothari shared a blunt distribution tip for B2B founders avoiding LinkedIn's "egregious" ad CPMs: just aggregate what's already trending on X and repost it there, since LinkedIn is consistently a week or two behind and its audience eats it up regardless. He adds a self-aware jab that anyone who keeps doing this long enough eventually becomes a full-time "LinkedInfluencer," whether they intend to or not.
items.summaryZh: FPV Ventures合伙人Nikunj Kothari给不想在LinkedIn广告CPM上砸重金的B2B创始人分享了一个直白的分发技巧：直接把X上已经"爆"过的内容搬到LinkedIn上再发一遍，因为LinkedIn的内容节奏总是比X慢一到两周，而它的用户群却照单全收。他还自嘲一句——这么干得久了，谁都会不知不觉变成一名全职"LinkedIn网红"。
